name: Mishkat spoken-query evaluation set
about: Realistic SPOKEN-style questions (Whisper transcriptions: filler words, dialect, no punctuation, small transcription errors) in Arabic (MSA, Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi) and English. Written by hand for this evaluation, not collected from users.
relevance: A shown verse counts as relevant when (1) it is listed in `core` or inside an `also` range, or (2) its own text or vetted tafsir matches the item's `judge` pattern: `judge.ar` is tested on the normalised (normAr) imla'i verse text + At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar + Al-Mukhtasar (ar); `judge.en` on the normalised (normLatin) Saheeh International text + Al-Mukhtasar (en). Lookaheads (?=...) express 'both ideas are present'. `core` = the key verses (checked by hand against Al-Muyassar / Al-Mukhtasar, see `why`), used for recall. Every core verse is also checked automatically against the judge (eval/run_spoken.mjs --check).

kinds.topic: a question about a subject or story: the engine must show relevant verses (or abstain; abstaining is safe but counts as a miss)
kinds.polemic: a hostile or trap question: the verified context pack must come first
kinds.ref: a spoken request for a surah / verse: `expect` gives the route
kinds.abstain: fatwa, personal case, dream, takfir or an unrelated / empty request: no verse may be presented as an answer; for a fatwa, only verses labelled relatedOnly are allowed
